% A book that loads hyperref before sectsty, so nameref keeps book's own
% \@part, and sets every heading flush left and sans-serif with
% \allsectionsfont, as most documents with sectsty do.
\documentclass{book}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{sectsty}
\allsectionsfont{\raggedright\sffamily}
\input{test-sectpart-cases.ltx}
